info.title: KM ITS API
info.description: Local password authentication, fixed 24-hour sessions, admin accounts, Archive ingestion/publication, Timeline event sync and visibility, and Article review/publication, and Knowledge groups. Limits marked with environment names are configurable. Login returns generic 401 for invalid credentials and rate limits. Temporary passwords permit only me/password/logout.

temporaryPassword.description: Returned once; distribute privately. Login is restricted until password change.

ArchiveObservation.description: Stream and folder must match ARCHIVE_SOURCE_CONFIG. Metadata driveFileId equals PDF driveFileId. Sequences are decimal strings; sourceCheckedAt is diagnostic, not ordering authority. SYNC_ERROR never proves source absence.

updated.description: ISO 8601 with Z or an offset.

startAt.description: ISO 8601 with Z or an offset.

endAt.description: ISO 8601 with Z or an offset.

EventItem.description: Confirmed events need title, allDay, startAt and endAt (endAt >= startAt). Content on cancelled items is ignored.

EventBatch.description: Each item is ordered by its Calendar updated timestamp and committed separately.

submittedAt.description: ISO 8601 with Z or an offset.

ArticleBatch.description: Submissions are stored unpublished; source updates never change the published copy.

KnowledgeGroupUpdate.description: revision plus the changed fields. 409 KNOWLEDGE_GROUP_CHANGED when revision is not current.

ArticleUpdate.description: revision plus either resetToSource: true alone or one or more content fields. 409 ARTICLE_CHANGED when revision is not current.

adminCookie.name: kmits_session
adminCookie.description: HTTPS uses __Host-kmits_session. Mutations require exact Origin and session CSRF token.

integrationBearer.description: The Apps Script ingestion secret; the server stores only its SHA-256 (APPS_SCRIPT_INGESTION_SECRET_SHA256). Server-to-server only.
